# Pinned CycloneDX 1.6 JSON schemas

These files were downloaded from the official CycloneDX schema endpoints on 2026-07-26 and are used only to validate
the generated release SBOM. They are reviewed source inputs rather than dynamically downloaded workflow dependencies.
CycloneDX specifications and schemas are provided by OWASP under Apache License 2.0.
